features.title: Tool outcome envelope
features.blurb: Every tool result flows through one envelope: compact payload on success, one error + one concrete correction on failure, receipts always.

steps.title: Create a solid brake pedal (headless) and show me the receipt.
steps.prompt: Create a solid aluminum brake pedal headless and show me the tool receipt.
talking_points: Point at the receipt block: tool, elapsed_s, changed fields.
No error fields on success — compact payloads keep LLM context clean.

steps.title: Force a failure: one error + one concrete correction.
steps.prompt: Request an invalid CAD create (unknown web type) and show me the failure envelope.
talking_points: error_class is machine-readable (bad_params), not prose.
Exactly one correction, concrete enough for the agent to retry on its own.

steps.title: Wrong-order usage self-heals.
steps.prompt: Query results before any solve, then follow the tool's correction to do it in the right order.
talking_points: The correction is actionable — the agent reads it and re-plans.
Debug details go to a log file, never into the LLM context.

features.title: Pre-mesh B-Rep validation gate
features.blurb: Deterministic geometry checks run before FreeCAD ever launches — degenerate params fail instantly with a correction.

steps.title: Degenerate param rejected at the host gate.
steps.prompt: Try to create an X-truss brake pedal with strut_radius_mm set to 0.
talking_points: Fails before FreeCAD launches — instant, no process spawned.
validation.stage is params_nonpositive with one concrete correction.

steps.title: Valid build shows the passed validation block.
steps.prompt: Create a valid X-truss brake pedal (headless) and show me the validation block.
talking_points: stage passed, is_valid true, volume_vs_estimate sanity check.
The gate sits before meshing in the generated solve script.

features.title: Design program layer
features.blurb: Persisted params + revision hash per part: the design program is the source of truth, geometry is derived.

steps.title: Read the persisted program.
steps.prompt: Read the design program for the brake pedal.
talking_points: Params + revision hash persisted on disk — the contract, not the mesh.
Idempotency: unchanged parameters are detected via SHA-256 hash (changed: false).

steps.title: Flagship edit: set cell size to 12, rebuild, commit.
steps.prompt: Set the X-truss pedal cell size to 12 mm and rebuild — commit the revision.
talking_points: Transactional edit: validate, rebuild, bump rev — atomically.
Edit + rebuild without recreating the part.

steps.title: Failed rebuild keeps the accepted revision.
steps.prompt: Try an out-of-range edit (cell size 40 mm), then read the program again.
talking_points: Out-of-range rejected cleanly; the accepted revision survives on disk.
Failed rebuilds must never clobber the accepted revision.

features.title: Run history + query_results
features.blurb: Every solve appends a per-run record; the agent can query where the stress is and what the recent runs said.

steps.title: Solve once, then ask where the stress is.
steps.prompt: Solve the current brake pedal headless, then tell me where the stress is concentrated.
talking_points: Hotspot query answered from the run record, not re-solved.
max_vm_location_mm rides with the KPIs.

steps.title: Query the history rows.
steps.prompt: Show the recent run rows for this part.
talking_points: Compact rows: method, sigma, SF, mesh size, timestamp.
Append-only record on disk — audit-friendly.

features.title: Pre-flight analytical estimates
features.blurb: Every 3D solve is cross-checked against closed-form Euler-Bernoulli beam theory — divergence is flagged, assumptions are stated.

steps.title: Solve and read the expectation block.
steps.prompt: Solve the brake pedal headless and show me the expected-vs-actual block.
talking_points: Expected ~45.06 MPa from 1D beam theory, actual ~23.7, ratio ~0.53.
divergence_flag false — the idealization gap is stated, not hidden.

steps.title: State the assumptions the number is judged against.
steps.prompt: What assumptions and caveats apply to my last solve?
talking_points: Assumptions + caveat strings ship with the result.
Linear elastic solve on PA12 carries viscoelastic NOT VERIFIED disclaimers.

features.title: Mesh convergence study
features.blurb: run_convergence_study watches stress move across mesh sizes, recommends refinement, and refuses honestly when a setup can't converge.

steps.title: Live study on the cantilever.
steps.prompt: Run a mesh convergence study on the cantilever beam.
talking_points: Coarse tets under-predict; the tool says refine further with a recommended size.
Verdict + recommended_mesh_max_size_mm come back with the runs.

steps.title: The honest refusal.
steps.prompt: Try a convergence study on an FCC brake pedal.
talking_points: error_class unsupported_setup — KPIs cannot converge for fcc.
The correction points at xtruss/solid instead of pretending.

features.title: Material as parameter
features.blurb: Materials are program parameters with selection guidance: compare with citations, switch with a revision bump, unknowns name every valid option.

steps.title: Compare Ti vs Al with citations.
steps.prompt: Compare Ti-6Al-4V vs Al 6061-T6 for the current part, with citations.
talking_points: Scales stored runs per material — instant, no re-solve.
Recommendation carries mass and safety factor, grounded in docs.

steps.title: Switch the pedal to titanium.
steps.prompt: Switch the pedal to Ti-6Al-4V and re-solve the +500 N load.
talking_points: Program edit -> rev bump -> rebuild -> re-solve, transactionally.
Density and modulus flow through every KPI.

steps.title: The honest correction.
steps.prompt: Switch the bracket to vibranium.
talking_points: Unknown material names every valid option instead of guessing.
Valid set: al6061t6, al7075t6, ti6al4v, pa12, steel.

features.title: UAV arm flagship
features.blurb: Parametric quadcopter arm: solid core vs 2.5D X-truss lattice with chord rails — about 17% mass reduction at 120 N tip thrust.

steps.title: Create the solid arm.
steps.prompt: Create the solid UAV arm in aluminum 6061-T6 (headless) and show me the mass.
talking_points: Flagship aerospace part family, same generator pattern as the pedal.
Solid is the baseline: ~157 g.

steps.title: Lattice variant with chord rails.
steps.prompt: Create the UAV arm with the X-truss lattice web and 1.5 mm chord rails, then compare mass to the solid.
talking_points: X-truss lands ~130 g — about 17% lighter.
Strut-radius program floor is 1.5 mm; chord rails 1.5 mm.

steps.title: Solve the 120 N tip thrust.
steps.prompt: Solve the 120 N tip thrust on the X-truss UAV arm.
talking_points: Goldens captured at 120 N.
Mesh guidance is per-variant (solid vs xtruss floors differ).

features.title: Hybrid retrieval + RAG Lab
features.blurb: TF-IDF + BM25 fused with RRF, a grounding-confidence label, and an inspectable RAG Lab — retrieval you can audit, not trust-me RAG.

steps.title: Grounded answer with the retrieval inspector.
steps.prompt: What is the yield strength of Al 6061-T6?
talking_points: Open the retrieval inspector: chunk text + tfidf/bm25 ranks.
Grounding badge shows strong — the answer cites docs/reference.

steps.title: Honest miss on an unknown material.
steps.prompt: What is the tensile strength of unobtainium?
talking_points: Amber weak/none grounding badge.
The agent says it does not know instead of inventing a number.

steps.title: RAG Lab: BM25 rescues, RRF fuses.
steps.prompt: Open the RAG Lab and search for ti64.
talking_points: TF-IDF misranks, BM25 rescues, the fused ranking wins — shown, not claimed.
Ranker comparison and index stats live in one inspector page.

features.title: Curated RAG corpus (allowlist)
features.blurb: Corpus ingestion is a declared allowlist that fails closed: only docs/reference and docs/adr get in, and the corpus fingerprint rides in the eval report.

steps.title: How big is the corpus?
steps.prompt: How many documents are in your grounding corpus, and where do they come from?
talking_points: Exactly the allowlisted docs — docs/reference + docs/adr.
ADRs stay in the corpus so the agent can explain its own decisions.

steps.title: A stray file stays invisible.
steps.prompt: What would happen if someone dropped a scratch markdown file into docs/?
talking_points: Fail closed: the stray file is invisible to the agent until declared.
Corpus fingerprint is recorded in the eval report — re-baselines are visible.
